name: ticket-flow
description: Keep Jira tickets in step with their GitHub PRs: sync statuses, clean up merged PR stacks, and catch branches up with master.

plugins.name: ticket-flow
plugins.description: Four skills: jira-sync moves tickets forward to match their PRs, stack-cleanup closes the lower PRs of a merged stack, catch-up merges master into a branch and pushes, and address-comments fixes review comments and merges the fix up the stack.
